parts.label: Q3(a)
parts.technique: Differentiation to find gradient of tangent
parts.reason: Standard differentiation of quadratic and evaluating gradient, P7.1/P7.3.

parts.label: Q3(b)
parts.technique: Gradient of a chord expressed algebraically
parts.reason: Finding gradient of PQ in terms of h, links to gradient as a limit, P7.1 explicitly covers gradient of tangent as a limit and this is the chord version leading to it.

parts.label: Q3(c)
parts.technique: Explain relationship between chord gradient limit and tangent gradient
parts.reason: Directly matches P7.1's statement about the gradient of the tangent as a limit of chord gradients.

parts.label: Q4(a)
parts.technique: Trigonometry - finding angle using cosine ratio in radians
parts.reason: Basic right-angle trig to find an angle, radian measure context, covered by P5.1 and general trig P5.5/P5.1.

parts.label: Q4(b)
parts.technique: Area of sector and triangle using radians
parts.reason: Uses A=1/2 r^2 theta and triangle area formulae, explicitly covered by P5.1 guidance.

parts.label: Q4(c)
parts.technique: Arc length using radians
parts.reason: Uses s=r theta, explicitly covered by P5.1.

parts.label: Q5(a)
parts.technique: Solving cubic equation by factorisation
parts.reason: Factorising a cubic (common factor + quadratic factorisation), covered by P2.6.

parts.label: Q5(b)
parts.technique: Solving equation in a function of the unknown using substitution
parts.reason: Solving equations that are a function of (y+3), explicitly matches P2.3 guidance on quadratic/related equations in function of the unknown, extended to a cubic-type substitution consistent with P2.4/P2.6 techniques.

parts.label: Q6(a)
parts.technique: Equation of a line parallel to a given line through a point
parts.reason: Directly matches P3.1 guidance on equation of line parallel to a given line through a given point.

parts.label: Q6(b)
parts.technique: Area of parallelogram using coordinate geometry
parts.reason: Uses straight line coordinate geometry (intercepts, distances) to find area; consistent with P3.1 straight line applications.

parts.label: Q6(c)
parts.technique: Finding vertex of parallelogram using vector/coordinate methods
parts.reason: Uses properties of parallelogram with straight line coordinate geometry, consistent with P3.1.

parts.label: Q7(a)
parts.technique: Sine function graph - coordinates of key points
parts.reason: Reading coordinates from a sine graph (degrees), covered by P5.3 graphs of sin/cos and P2.9 transformations.

parts.label: Q7(b)
parts.technique: Transformation of trig graph (vertical translation) and minimum point
parts.reason: Vertical translation of sine graph y=f(x)+a and finding minimum point, covered by P2.9 and P5.3.

parts.label: Q8
parts.technique: Discriminant condition for no real roots of simultaneous line/quadratic and solving resulting quadratic inequality in k
parts.reason: Combines simultaneous equations (P2.4), discriminant condition b^2-4ac<0 (P2.3), and quadratic inequality solving (P2.5) - all explicitly in spec.

parts.label: Q9
parts.technique: Differentiation of rational/surd expression after algebraic manipulation, solve for stationary point
parts.reason: Splitting fraction into sum of powers of x and differentiating x^n for rational n, then solving for x - covered by P7.2/P7.3.

parts.label: Q10(a)
parts.technique: Sketching cubic curve with repeated root, axis intercepts
parts.reason: Sketching curves defined by simple polynomial equations including repeated roots, covered by P2.7.

parts.label: Q10(b)
parts.technique: Function transformation f(x/4) and vertical translation
parts.reason: Use of transformations y=f(ax) and y=f(x)+a, covered by P2.9.

parts.label: Q10(c)
parts.technique: Horizontal translation transformation f(x+1) and evaluating y-intercept
parts.reason: Transformation y=f(x+a), expanding resulting cubic, covered by P2.9 and P2.6 (expanding polynomials).

parts.label: Q11(a)
parts.technique: Equation of normal to a curve at a point
parts.reason: Standard application of gradients of tangents/normals, covered by P7.3.

parts.label: Q11(b)
parts.technique: Integrating second derivative twice (including negative fractional powers) using given conditions to find constants
parts.reason: Integration of x^n for rational n and constants of integration determined from given points, covered by P8.1/P8.2 and P7.2 differentiation checks.
